scope: Every club in England's 2025-26 National League 1 (level 3), National League 2 North, East and West (level 4), Regional 1 (level 5), Regional 2 (level 6) and Counties 1 (level 7) leagues, first XVs only, grouped by its RFU constituent body (county), with the three Crown Dependency clubs in the English leagues under the unions they play in (Jersey and Guernsey Raiders in Hampshire, Douglas in Cheshire). Lines are 2025-26 final places from Wikipedia. Each county's clubs are in pyramid order (level, then place).
notes: Every club carries id, name, fullName, county and code (its county), kit, trim, hoops, kitConfidence, league, level, place, w, d, l, pf and pa, existingId, countyConfidence and sources; existingDiff and note where they apply.

w, d, l, pf and pa are null where Wikipedia has no 2025-26 table (every Counties 1 league bar Counties 1 Western West, plus Regional 2 North East and Regional 2 Thames): only the place is real for those clubs. A search pass for those tables (enrich/records-*.json) found none. Every National League club has its full line.

name fits the game's 16-character card (importShort) and no two names are the same to the game's importSame; fullName is the club's own. Existing clubs keep the game's name, kit and line; existingDiff says what the research found.
Every county has at least six clubs, so topUps is empty everywhere (no Counties 2 top-ups were needed). levels counts each county's clubs by level.

existingBelowScope lists the game's own clubs from Counties 2 to 5 that belong to the county and are not in this file; keep them. Their kits (with Merton's as gameKitChanges leaves it) were included when the guesses were kept distinct.
label is the county's name on the card's group button and in the Filter; labelWraps marks a label that may take two lines (Northumberland's label carries a soft hyphen, U+00AD).
cups use the game's COUNTY_CUPS shape plus 'from'; a null from or to is not sourced. cupLevels says how much of it is sourced.

kitConfidence, one rule applied both ways: 'confirmed' needs words that state the colours from the club itself (its site, news, history, rules, programme or other own publication, or a Wikipedia sentence citing one of them) or from its county union (a club directory or club page); 'reported' is any other support (a drawn infobox kit, a nickname, merchandise or a kit supplier's listing, a league's colours list, the press, Wikipedia prose that cites no club publication); 'guess' is a free choice. A part no source gives (often the pattern, sometimes the trim) is a free choice even on a sourced kit, and the record's sources say which.

Kits are distinct within each county list, every level and the game's own clubs below Counties 1 included: two kits look the same when the shirts are within 60 of each other and the trims within 60 (the game's colorDist; 60 is where importPair drops a trim as unreadable), a trim closer than 60 to its shirt counting as none. Only guesses move, and a guess is never separated by hoops alone; a guessed trim must read against its shirt (colorDist 90 or more and a contrast ratio of 1.5 or more), and a moved guess takes a trim with a contrast of 2 or more where one is free. Sourced kits that look alike stay (decided). Black is written #1c1c1c, the game's black.

Clubs that did not finish 2025-26 are left out: Old Cooperians (withdrew October 2025) and Mavericks (December 2025) from Counties 1 Essex, and Uckfield (withdrew a month before the season) from Counties 1 Surrey/Sussex. A club that finished 2025-26 and withdrew later is kept: Edwardians, who withdrew a week before 2026-27.
countyConfidence 'inferred' remains for two clubs, HAC and Brunel University (both placed in Middlesex); each needs a search to confirm.
decided lists every choice made for this file, by the owner or by the orchestrator (who may be overruled); gameKitChanges lists the game's own kits a decision changes.

decided.topic: Local is By County, England only
decided.decision: Every club in England's 2025-26 Regional 1, Regional 2 and Counties 1 leagues, by county. Layout: Build. The Filter's England lists National, Premiership, Championship, then Surrey, then every other county A to Z; search finds any club with its path ('North · England · Kent'). The team card shows the county on its group button (two lines allowed for long names) and the small line above it drops 'Local'. Competitions' Local tier is your county (My Team's club's county; Surrey when it has none) | Other County | My League (when one is imported); Other County opens the Filter on County | Teams and a pick starts that county's championship.

Add Them: the 55 clubs of National League 1 (level 3) and National League 2 North, East and West (level 4) go into their counties' club lists with their real 2025-26 lines, rated just above Regional 1 and below England 2. Guernsey Raiders, the 56th, is in Hampshire with the Crown Dependency clubs.
Include: Jersey and Guernsey Raiders under Hampshire, Douglas (Isle of Man) under Cheshire, the unions they play under.
